tytul: Traditional sugar-free plum butter: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for traditional Polish plum butter (powidła) made without sugar and cooked down over several days.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to NCHFP, sugar is the preservative in jellied fruit products and prevents the growth of microorganisms; never reduce the amount of sugar a recipe calls for.

Open-kettle canning, filling jars with hot food and sealing them without processing, is not recommended: the temperatures it reaches are not high enough to destroy all spoilage and food poisoning organisms that may be in the food.
Open-kettle canning and processing filled jars in an oven, a microwave oven or a dishwasher are not recommended, because they do not prevent all risks of spoilage.

akapity: According to Oregon State University Extension, fruit butters can be made from most high-acid fruits, among them plums.
The basic fruit butter recipe from Oregon State University Extension uses sugar; it gives no sugar-free version, only a lower-sugar option with honey.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for plum butter without sugar from a checked source.
